summary: Cass County tower listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no second source found for its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Nushka as a gone tower in Cass County at 47.36190, -94.11401

sources.title: Minnesota Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLA Minnesota list gives name, county, coordinates and gone status only. Two web searches (Nushka lookout tower Cass County; Nushka Minnesota lookout tower history) found no page naming it, and the NHLR and FFLOS caches have no page for it. The name may be a variant spelling. The story is deliberately short; hold it or publish as a stub until a second source turns up. Leads: the FFLA catalog of historical and extant Minnesota fire towers, Cass County or Minnesota DNR records, a local historical society.
